title: Embedding a machine contract
statement: Let a machine with $m$ work tapes be embedded into a machine with $k$ work tapes by an injection of tape indices, and let a contract describe its computation from an entry state to a prescribed set of exit states. The induced contract for the embedded machine uses the restriction of each starting configuration to the embedded tapes for its precondition and running time, embeds the original endpoint into the larger configuration, and extends the head-position bounds by keeping each unused tape's head at its starting position.
hypotheses_covered: An embedding of the $m$ work-tape indices into the $k$ work-tape indices
A contract for the original machine, entry state, exit set, data type, and input
